textRuns.value: Delivery model: Random Forest, test R² −0.0022, RMSE 9.774 minutes, target was R² ≥ 0.75 and RMSE ≤ 6. It does not beat predicting the mean. Shuffling any feature changes RMSE by at most a few thousandths of a minute. Churn model: 87.4% of customers have no order in the 60 days after 1 Nov 2024. Test F1 is 0.9326, the same as predicting that everyone churns. ROC-AUC is 0.514. Risk bands do not separate churners (about 86–89% in every band). Do not run a win-back campaign from these scores.
